record.body: Signature marine soundscapes are designed ocean soundscapes with all three layers: designed whale-like song and dolphin-like whistles, designed fish choruses and shrimp-like snapping, designed waves and rain on the sea, and designed shipping and sonar. The design states a masking rule, that designed shipping raises background levels and shrinks the audible range of designed whale-like song by a computed factor, modeling marine noise concern without claiming any real ocean's levels. This record covers all three Signature layers, stated separately, never blurred.

demo.code:
TITLE = 'Signature Marine Soundscapes: Designed Ocean Layers'
import math
BIO = 58
GEO = 53
ANTH = 66
tot = 10 * math.log10(10 ** (BIO / 10.0) + 10 ** (GEO / 10.0) + 10 ** (ANTH / 10.0))
dom = 'biophony' if BIO >= GEO and BIO >= ANTH else ('geophony' if GEO >= ANTH else 'anthrophony')
print('Record: ' + TITLE)
print('Biophony: %.1f decibels' % BIO)
print('Geophony: %.1f decibels' % GEO)
print('Anthrophony: %.1f decibels' % ANTH)
print('Combined soundscape level: %.1f decibels' % tot)
print('Dominant layer: ' + dom)
print('Layers are mixed in arithmetic but kept distinct in description.')
